forced_scenarios.title: Abrade: announced modes, damage and artifact destruction
forced_scenarios.result: Creature mode marked 3 damage on a 1-toughness creature (survived=False); artifact mode destroyed its chosen ramp permanent.

forced_scenarios.title: Capsize: successful buyback, then a countered recast
forced_scenarios.result: First cast returned the target and Capsize to hand. After an explicitly advanced untap, the second bought-back cast was countered; Capsize entered the graveyard.

forced_scenarios.title: Arcane Adaptation: live Wizard types and captured triggers
forced_scenarios.result: Adaptation made Iconoclast a Wizard. Harmonic Prodigy doubled triggers from Preordain and the responding Capsize (4 Soldiers). Capsize bounced Adaptation; already queued triggers survived. A later Ponder produced only 1 Soldier.

forced_scenarios.title: Frantic Search: atomic selection, untap and source reuse
forced_scenarios.result: Drew 2, discarded 2, untapped 3 actual lands. Young Pyromancer then reused restored source IDs [434] in the same main phase.

forced_scenarios.title: Combat: response after blocks and persistent blocked status
forced_scenarios.result: Goblin Electromancer was blocked. Capsize bounced the blocker in the post-block priority window. The attacker remained blocked and dealt zero player damage (no trample).

caveat: Infrastructure diagnostics; not empirical Commander win rates
